text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout v3.14 -> canary (eu-west-1) at 02:30 UTC. change window shifted by request from infra to avoid client blackout. canary size 5%. smoke suite = quickwatch + mosaic-synth (regional sampling). running prefill + kv warmup, will post results. links: https://dash/release/1774137600 :deploy:
emma.k: thanks. are we reducing mosaic fanout because of the shifted window?
raj: yeah suggest cutting regional fanout from 20 -> 6 for initial pass, then scale up if stable. less noise and cheaper during off-hours.
lucas: +1. Also make sure tokenizer warmup job runs before probes. last time p95 blipped until tokenizers loaded.
sre-oncall: seeing a small p95 embed latency bump in eu-west-1 after start — p95 +18% at 02:42, 503 count rose 5->12 in 5m. attaching quick logs: `curl -s https://metrics/api?range=5m&node=eu-west-1` (link)
emma.k: link looks like https://dash/metrics/shot?m=embed_p95&region=eu-west-1 . can someone paste the probe output?
raj: mosaic-synth sample results: region eu-west-1: 50 samples, p50 120ms, p95 520ms (baseline p95 440ms), errors 2. other regions nominal.
lucas: that's a blip, p50 is fine. suspect tokenizer cache. recommend extend warmup by +10m and rerun mosaic-synth with fanout=6.
emma.k: ok let's hold canary for eu-west-1. do not roll forward. other regions continue.
raj: if we don't see improvement after warmup+rerun, fallback option is rollback to v3.13 for eu-west-1 canary only.
deploy-bot: action: pin canary eu-west-1 -> v3.13 (isolated) at 02:55 UTC. continuing rollout in other regions. notified release owner @emma.k :pushpin:
sre-oncall: creating incident ticket low-priority: INC-20260322-1774. will monitor for 30m.
lucas: ops checklist to rerun smoke (run locally or via deploy-bot):
```
# re-run mosaic-synth with smaller fanout
deploy-bot rerun-smoke --suite mosaic-synth --region eu-west-1 --fanout 6 --warmup 600
# check quickwatch summary
curl -s https://dash/api/releases/1774137600/quickwatch | jq .summary
```

emma.k: executing warmup now, will post results in 10m. tagging @raj to keep an eye on kv warmup.
raj: watching. if errors persist we'll trigger rollback plan B. also prepping a tokenizer hotfix branch just in case.
deploy-bot: warmup started (tokenizer cache priming + kv prefill). estimated completion 03:05 UTC.
lucas: note — if mosaic-synth still shows p95 delta >+10% after rerun we'll open rollback call. otherwise proceed to slow ramp.
emma.k: warmup complete. mosaic-synth rerun results: 50 samples, p50 115ms, p95 455ms, errors 0. back within baseline window.
raj: nice. recommend unpinning and proceeding with a conservative ramp for eu-west-1: 5% -> 20% over 30m.
emma.k: agreed. unpinning eu-west-1 canary and resuming rollout at 03:20 UTC with gradual ramp. will monitor tail latency for next 60m.
sre-oncall: closing INC-20260322-1774 as resolved but leaving runbook note about tokenizer warmup in off-hours flows.
lucas: follow-up action: add a pre-deploy tokenizer warmup job to the change-window checklist to prevent recurrence.
emma.k: noted, i'll add it to the release notes and the deploy checklist: `- run tokenizer warmup 10m before smoke`.
deploy-bot: rollout resumed and ramp scheduled. status: eu-west-1 canary -> v3.14 (ramp 5%->20% over 30m). all other regions continuing. summary posted to https://dash/release/1774137600/summary :white_check_mark:
